history.title: Our story
history.p1: Founded in Cameroon in 2019, Camer-Ossaka Connexion links local craft with European construction standards — adapted to the site, not copied from a template.
history.p2: From early sites in Douala to work abroad, our name rests on execution, clear commitments and teams that keep growing.
history.p3: We work with private clients, companies and institutions on buildings and infrastructure, held to four tests: quality, integrity, method and solidarity.

team.title: Leadership
team.joinDesc: C-O Connexion matches construction talent with companies. Browse openings or submit your profile.

jeanMarie.role: Founder of Camer-Ossaka Connexion & Civil Engineer
jeanMarie.bio: A civil engineer and entrepreneur, he graduated from the University of Buea and holds a Master’s degree from Germany. He specializes in infrastructure and environmental engineering. At Camer-Ossaka Connexion, he applies his international expertise to infrastructure development, strategic investment and partnerships across Africa.

livine.role: Co-founder of Camer-Ossaka Connexion & Civil Engineer
livine.bio: A civil engineer with a Master’s degree in civil engineering, she combines technical expertise with an entrepreneurial outlook. She contributes to strategy, project development, innovation, partnerships and sustainable development.

yannick.role: Co-founder of Camer-Ossaka Connexion & Software Engineer
yannick.bio: A computer engineer and entrepreneur, he studied electrical engineering and automation in Germany and specializes in smart solutions and innovative technologies. At Camer-Ossaka Connexion, he contributes to digital transformation, automation and the company’s technological development.
